svg.title: Figure 1. The item boundary in the DFA view
svg.desc: The WP-C-01 item boundary with the WP-A-03 dependent failure analysis on it. E-04 comma device hardware: depends on R-01, R-02, R-03, R-05, R-07, R-16. E-01 SoC software (openpilot): depends on R-02, R-04, R-05, R-07, R-08, R-09, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-14, R-15. E-02 ML models: depends on R-02, R-05, R-08, R-14, R-17. E-03 panda safety MCU: depends on R-02, R-04, R-05, R-06, R-07, R-09, R-10, R-11, R-12, R-13, R-15. E-05 harness and harness box: depends on R-01, R-03, R-06, R-16. Cluster, cruise indicator: depends on R-01, R-09. PCM, ACC execution: depends on R-01, R-06, R-09, R-10, R-16. EPS: depends on R-01, R-06, R-09, R-10, R-16. Stock camera and PCS: depends on R-03, R-16. Driver: depends on R-17. IC-01 (Not independent): not analysed R-10. IC-02 (Partly): not analysed R-06. IC-03 (Open): not analysed none. IC-04 (Partly): not analysed R-01, R-06, R-10, R-16. IC-05 (Not independent): not analysed R-09, R-10. IC-06 (Not independent): not analysed R-05, R-06, R-09, R-10, R-12, R-13, R-15, R-16.

Generated by dfa_figures.py from shared-resources.yaml, and-gates.yaml and WP-A-03. Where each claim is drawn is CLAIM_AT in the script; the resource map is an AI-assisted draft.

g.text: Terms: ACC adaptive cruise control · AI artificial intelligence · CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · DFA dependent failure analysis · E-nn element of the item (WP-C-01 §3.1), E-01…E-06 · EMC

electromagnetic compatibility: interference between electrical parts and wiring · EPS electric power steering · HMI human-machine interface: display, sounds, cluster · HSE high-speed external oscillator: the crystal

that clocks the panda MCU · IC-nn independence claim (WP-A-03 §2): two elements the safety concept relies on not failing together · IF-nn interface of the item (WP-C-01 §3.4) · IPC inter-process communication ·

LD-SDA LionDriver Supervised Driving Assistance, the item · MCU microcontroller: the panda safety processor (STM32H7) · ML machine learning · OI-nn open item of the document it appears in · OS-nn operational

situation (HARA §3) · PCB printed circuit board · PCM powertrain control module (engine and drive) · PCS pre-collision system: Toyota's stock collision warning and braking · R-nn shared resource in the DFA map

(08-analyses/dfa/shared-resources.yaml): something two elements both depend on · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot (QM) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its
area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K safety case)
